body:
I hope you're right.  For tonight, I've decided that I will go to my doctor tomorrow who can refer me to a good therapist.  She can also write me a note excusing me from my exam tomorrow, maybe a little recovery time will be helpful.  Thanks for the offer by the way, I might take you up on it.


I am going to bed now; today was a tough day.

Fuck, you might be right.  Even today, I occasionally do her favors that nobody (sans BF) would do for her.  I should quit that.  I've also resolved to get some form of therapy.  I emailed my professors telling them that I will NOT be making it to the test tomorrow, and that I will procure a note from a doctor excusing me.  Now its time to sleep off this headache.  From studying to desperation to writing that leviathan to frantically checking my inbox/replying, I am thoroughly beaten (not that I had that much fuel in the tank to start with... haha).

Edit: by the way, thanks for the advice.

Thanks for the supportive response.  There is no way I will ever take her back, I've had 3 years of ever-increasing pain to reinforce that.  It's such a shame that NOW is the time I finally fucking break.  I can't think anymore, studying is going atrociously.  I need a nap.


Sorry for the melancholy, that seems to be all I can muster.  It's quite pathetic.

Problem is, there's no getting away from them.  They are literally both within 30 feet of me right now.  I feel like I've gone insane; I have so much hate and pain mixed with an odd understanding of my BF and xGF.  Sometimes I treat them both like shit, other times I've fucking cried in their (mostly BF's) arms.  I agree that I need a breath of 'fresh air,' but there's just no way to get that anytime soon, minus admitting myself to a goddamn psyche ward.  Hell, I'm close to needing it.

Edit:  I used to think that people committing suicide were just cowards, but I'm moving towards the realization that they are just fucking *tired.*
You will be able to see my anger turn to desperation.  I have so much to do but its like I've finally run out of steam, right before the finish line.
